meta.title: orangekoko — One-of-a-kind vintage jewelry from Japan
meta.description: orangekoko brings singular vintage jewelry sourced across Japan to Europe. Every piece is one of one, worn before, carrying its own trace of time.

hero.subtitle: One-of-one jewelry, sourced in Japan, with age, patina and atmosphere

home.storyBody1: We travel across Japan to find pieces with a beauty that time alone can create.
home.storyBody2: Each one-of-one treasure is selected by hand for its craftsmanship, material and quiet presence.
home.storyBody3: We believe vintage jewelry carries memory — and becomes part of yours.
home.condition1: Every piece is pre-loved and shows honest signs of age.
home.condition2: We never erase the past — those marks are part of the beauty.
home.condition3: We check clasps, settings and stones by hand.
home.condition4: We describe condition clearly so you can shop with confidence.
home.condition5: What you see is what you receive.
home.feature1Body: Carefully packed in Tokyo and shipped with care.
home.feature2Body: Mindful packaging, ready to give or keep.
home.feature3Body: One-of-one vintage, sourced in Japan and selected by hand.
home.feature4Body: Our team is here for you before and after your order.

product.onlyOneAvailable: Only one of this piece exists
product.shippingBody: Shipped insured from Japan. Estimated delivery within the EU: 6–12 business days.
product.careBody: Vintage jewelry asks for gentle handling: store away from moisture, avoid perfume and direct contact with water.
